name: plain-skills-free
description: Free plain-text skills for Claude Code: stop runaway loops, hand work to the next session, ask before building, review a skill before you install it.

plugins.name: loop-stop
plugins.description: Give every long-running sub-task a brief, a limit and a stop rule, so a loop does not burn your quota.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Write a short HANDOFF.md from real command output so the next session continues without asking where you were.

plugins.name: ask-before-building
plugins.description: Ask up to 5 questions with a recommended answer, agree the plan in 5 lines, and only then write code.

plugins.name: skill-check
plugins.description: Review a SKILL.md for safety and quality before you install it. Reads the file as data and returns a short pass/fix list.
